create_FNetConfig_default: create an FNetConfig instance with default fnet-base configuration values
create_FNetConfig_custom: create an FNetConfig instance with custom vocab_size, hidden_size, and num_hidden_layers
create_FNetConfig_tpu: create an FNetConfig instance with TPU fourier optimizations enabled and tpu_short_seq_length set
create_FNetConfig_from_dict: create an FNetConfig instance from a dictionary of configuration parameters
create_FNetConfig_to_dict: create a dictionary from an FNetConfig instance using to_dict method
